analysis.transcript_summary: An AI agent called on behalf of Maple Bakery to place an order, attempting to reach Dave or another person capable of taking an order. The call went to voicemail, and after several attempts to elicit a response, the agent left a message stating that no one was available and the owner would follow up. The agent then encountered difficulties disconnecting from the voicemail system, repeatedly responding to prompts before the call finally ended.
